items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: Do you remember any of the old rags, like the Joplin rags and all?

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the old rags, like the Joplin rags and all? Professor Renetta still played some of those. I was the old playing ball.
I don't remember. We played some of them.
